m.aarti.tek: Victory to you, Bhairava Deva; Lord, victory to you, Bhairava Deva. Gods, men and sages all serve you, Lord.
m.aarti.pad1: You deliver from sin and carry across the ocean of sorrow; you bring happiness to devotees and bear a fearsome form.
m.aarti.pad2: You are seated on your mount, the dog, and hold the trident in your hand. Your glory is boundless; victory, victory to you, remover of fear.
m.aarti.pad3: Without you, the service of Śiva bears no fruit. The sight of the four-wicked lamp takes away sorrow.
m.aarti.pad4: Before you are offerings crackled in oil and mixed with curd, and a string of praises to you. Have mercy, Bhairava; do not delay.
m.aarti.pad5: Ankle bells ring on his feet and he beats the ḍamaru; Baṭukanātha, taking the form of a child, gladdens people’s hearts.
m.aarti.pad6: Whoever sings the āratī of Baṭukanātha — says Dharaṇīdhara — gains the fruit his heart desires.
